title: Real lab: relay a port with socat
instruction: This is a real Alpine box with netcat and socat. A service answers on 127.0.0.1:8000 (try `curl 127.0.0.1:8000`). Use socat to open a NEW listening port 9999 that relays to that service, so `curl 127.0.0.1:9999` reaches it too. Background it with `&`, then click Verify.

verify.success: Solved! socat is relaying 9999 -> 8000. socat is the swiss-army knife for wiring sockets together.
verify.fail: Port 9999 isn't reaching the service yet. Start a socat relay from 9999 to 127.0.0.1:8000.

hint: socat TCP-LISTEN:9999,reuseaddr,fork TCP:127.0.0.1:8000 &     then check: curl 127.0.0.1:9999
